entries.title: Cozy Farm SFX - 50 farming game sound effects (tools, harvest, shop, UI, jingles)
entries.author: roberto mellado
entries.description: field-name-body field-type-text-with-summary field-label-hidden"> Cozy Farm SFX : 50 sound effects for cozy farming and life-sim games, WAV 44.1 kHz. Tools: hoe (2), axe chop, tree fall, pickaxe on rock, rock break, scythe swish, watering, seed planting Farm life: harvest pop, egg collect, fishing cast / bite / reel, splash, bush rustle, footsteps on grass, dirt and wood, eat, drink, sleep Shop and items: shop bell, sell coins, buy, not enough money, chest open, craft, place item, pickup (normal and rare), wooden door open / close, gate Interface: click, hover, confirm, back, error, menu open / close, inventory open, notification, dialogue blip Jingles: new day, good night, quest complete, level up, festival, fail Synthesized with our own code (oscillators, noise, envelopes and our own instruments). The 5 stereo ambience loops (rain, crickets, birds, wind, stream), the matching 16x16 Cozy Farm art and Cozy Farm Music are on itch.io: https://aquumgifts.itch.io/cozy-farm-sfx Every Cozy Farm art pack in one download: Cozy Farm Complete on itch.io (the Lite is free).

entries.title: Cozy SFX Sampler — 60 cute sound effects (UI, farm, RPG, retro, spooky, footsteps)
entries.author: roberto mellado
entries.description: field-name-body field-type-text-with-summary field-label-hidden"> 60 cute sound effects for cozy games, free under CC-BY 4.0. This is a sampler of Cozy SFX Complete : a few sounds from each of its 12 themes, ready for Godot, Unity, GameMaker, RPG Maker, Ren'Py and the web. Every sound was synthesized with our own code, no recorded samples. What's inside (one folder per theme): UI (6): click-bubble-1, confirm-1, popup-open, notify-chime, achievement, error-1 Farm (5): hoe-dig, watering, harvest-pop, axe-chop, sell-coins Cafe & Kitchen (5): pour-coffee, cash-register, kettle-whistle, sizzle, door-bell RPG (5): sword-swing-1, fireball, heal, chest-open, potion-drink Spooky (5): ghost-boo, cauldron-bubble, door-creak, pumpkin-pop, owl-hoot Retro 8-bit (6): jump-1, coin-1, power-up, laser, explosion-1, one-up Story / visual novel (5): choice-confirm, page-turn-1, idea, comedy-boing, blush Beach (5): seagull-1, wave-small, shell-pickup, splash-big, crab-scuttle Space (5): laser-small, warp, shield-up, explosion-small, computer-beeps Footsteps (6): step-grass-1, step-wood-1, step-stone-1, step-snow-1, step-water-1, step-gravel-1 Jingles (5): level-up-bright, item-get-warm, quest-complete-bright, game-over-warm, day-start-warm Nature ambience (2): forest-day-10s and rain-light-10s, 10-second excerpts with a short fade Format: WAV, 44.1 kHz, 16-bit. The sound effects are mono, normalized, and start and end in silence; the two nature excerpts are stereo. Credit: "Cozy SFX Sampler" by S

entries.title: Unreleased Zombie SFX
entries.author: Emma_MA
entries.description: field-name-body field-type-text-with-summary field-label-hidden"> In 2016/2017 I was working on a zombie game project that got abandoned. My main focus was working on the music, but I also created a lof of sound effects, which have been gathering dust on my harddrive since then. So hopefully others can get some use out of them. Most sounds were 8-bit(ish), but here is a collection of the more "normal" sound effects I created. I also didn't include any sounds that were completely unmodified from other sources (see below), since redistributing unmodified samples is not always allowed. The collection mostly contains things like boss roars and short fanfares. The fanfares (and anything else musical) were entirely created by me. The sound effects are built from layering sounds from: GDC Bundles (no restrictions on commercial use or modification, no attibution needed) 99Sounds (no restrictions on commercial use or modification, no attribution needed) 8dio (no restrictions on commercial use or modification, no attribution needed)
